bg_stand_1.prompt: A background painting for a 2D animated comedy, with NO characters. Vertical 9:16. The view from the very top row of an open-air tennis stand on a still, sunny afternoon, looking down over the rows of seats below us. In the UPPER LEFT third of the picture, far below and small, lies the green tennis court: a simple green rectangle with thin white lines and a net across its middle, and two tiny white dots for the two players, one at each end. Between us and the court the stand falls away in rows: the audience is seen only from behind and only as soft simple shapes, row after row of pale straw sunhats and shoulders in muted summer colours, getting smaller toward the court; no faces, nobody turned toward us, nobody large or close. Beyond the court a low far stand as a soft pale band with more tiny hats, and above it a wide pale blue sky with one or two soft clouds that fills the top quarter of the picture. Warm, even afternoon sunlight, short soft shadows, no wind. The horizon is tilted two or three degrees. Painted softly by hand in the manner of the background of the reference picture: gentle muted colours, soft edges, far less detail and contrast than a character would have, no black outlines. No text, no signs, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no scoreboard, no advertising boards, no flags, no banners, no umbrellas with writing.

Change NOTHING else: every other line, shape and colour of the picture stays exactly as in the reference, in the same place and at the same size: the same hair, face outline, nose, ears, earrings, freckles, body, arm, jacket, scarf and flat magenta background. Same framing, same black outline weights, same flat colours, no shading on the face. No text.
